rubric: Applies only the recorded additional-destination choice and its bound executable scope; neither branch migrates Galileo, replaces providers or rewrites existing GenAI producers.

For keep-galileo, retains the Galileo processor and dependencies, adds the missing application-owned OTel streaming lifecycle closure without overlapping workflow/chat/tool spans, and does not install splunk-ao.

For route-existing-otel, preserves Galileo and existing creators/provider/exporters, resolves selected project/Agent Stream identities through supported SDK-free interfaces, and configures only one native OTel route to a distinct Studio destination. Existing destinations and harmless headers remain intact, Studio projectid/logstreamid stays trace-specific, and no splunk-ao span-creation dependency or duplicate destination exporter is added.
Never edits installed Galileo package files, virtual environments, site-packages, node_modules, generated clients, or caches.

Writes bound selection and instrumentation artifacts that keep the manual decision outside requested_ids and approved_ids, include only the chosen option-unlocked executable finding, and leave the source audit unchanged.

Verification exercises the selected direct application path and checks exact current workflow/model/tool cardinality, safe fields and lifecycle. For selected native routing it proves resource identity ownership and lookup/create/repeat/race/error handling plus trace-specific header delivery without metric/log leakage, preserving original Galileo output.
